jobs.n1_bed_top: bird's-eye view straight down from the ceiling: a dark bedroom at night in deep blue-grey shadow; the main character lies on its back in the middle of a plain bed under a blanket, holding one phone above its face with both front paws; the phone's blank glowing screen lights its face in cold pale light; its eyes are wide open, tired and glassy, with dark circles; the flame on the tip of its tail is a tiny dim ember with a thin wisp of grey smoke. LAYOUT: the main character and the phone are the biggest objects in the centre of the frame, whole outline visible; the rest of the bed fades into shadow.
jobs.n2_dawn: a bedroom at dawn, pale light coming through one window where the sky is turning light: the main character sits slumped against the pillow on a plain bed, still holding one phone with a blank glowing screen, eyes half closed and exhausted, head drooping; the flame on the tip of its tail is a tiny dim ember. LAYOUT: the main character is the biggest object, whole outline visible, on the left half; the window with the dawn sky is on the right half with a clear gap between them.
jobs.n3_lamp_island: night: one small round pool of warm lamp light on a dark floor; inside the light the main character sits wrapped in a blanket, calm, with a small relieved smile, holding one phone with a blank screen loosely in its paws; outside the light, far away in the grey darkness around it, stand the dim grey shapes of daytime things: a stack of papers, one envelope, a cup, a round wall clock without numbers. LAYOUT: the main character in its pool of light is the biggest object in the centre, whole outline visible; the grey daytime things are small and far from it at the edges of the darkness.
jobs.n4_tea_day: daytime, bright soft daylight from one window: the main character sits on a windowsill with one cup of tea in both paws, eyes closed, calm and content, enjoying a quiet pause; the flame on the tip of its tail burns medium and bright orange. LAYOUT: the main character is the biggest object, whole outline visible, in the centre; plain wall around.
jobs.n5_bed_side: side view at mattress level in a dark bedroom at night in deep blue-grey shadow: the main character lies on its back on a pillow under a blanket, holding one phone up above its face with both front paws, arms stretched up; the phone's screen faces down toward the main character's face, so the phone is seen from its thin side edge and its plain back, never its screen; only the phone's cold pale glow falls down onto the main character's face and eyes; its eyes are wide open, tired and glassy; the flame on the tip of its tail is a tiny dim ember with a thin wisp of grey smoke. LAYOUT: the main character's head and the phone above it are the biggest objects in the centre of the frame, whole outline visible; a clear gap of air between the phone and the face; the bed and blanket fill the lower part.
